name: Page Category and Tag – Add Categories and Tags to WordPress Pages
author: iSmart Web Service

sections.description:
Page Category and Tag – Add Categories and Tags to WordPress Pages

By default, WordPress allows categories and tags only for posts. This plugin enables categories for pages and tags for pages, allowing you to organize your WordPress pages just like posts.

If you are searching for a simple way to:

✔ Add categories to pages
✔ Add tags to pages
✔ Enable page category in WordPress
✔ Enable page tag in WordPress
✔ Organize pages using taxonomy
✔ Improve internal linking structure

Then this lightweight plugin is the perfect solution.

After activation, the default WordPress Category and Tag taxonomies become available for Pages. You can assign, manage, and filter pages by category or tag directly from the dashboard.

No complex settings. No unnecessary features. Just activate and use.

Why Use Page Category and Tag Plugin?

Many websites need better content organization beyond blog posts. With page category and page tag support, you can:

  • Create structured service pages
  • Group landing pages by category
  • Filter pages by tag
  • Improve SEO architecture
  • Build better navigation systems
  • Improve user experience

This plugin integrates seamlessly with:

  • Gutenberg (Block Editor)
  • Classic Editor
  • WordPress REST API
  • Custom page templates

Key Features

  • Enable Category for Pages
  • Enable Tag for Pages
  • Assign categories to pages
  • Assign tags to pages
  • Filter pages by category
  • Filter pages by tag
  • Lightweight and fast
  • No configuration required
  • Works with any theme
  • SEO-friendly structure

Perfect For

  • Business websites
  • Corporate websites
  • Service-based websites
  • Directory websites
  • Educational websites
  • Large content platforms
  • SEO-focused websites
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/page-category-tag/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Pages → Add New or Edit Page.
  4. You will now see Category and Tag meta boxes available for pages.
  5. Start organizing your pages using categories and tags.
sections.faq:
Can I add categories to WordPress pages?

Yes. This plugin enables categories for WordPress pages instantly after activation.

Can I add tags to pages in WordPress?

Yes. It enables tag support for pages without modifying your theme.

Does this plugin affect blog posts?

No. It only enables category and tag support for pages. Posts remain unchanged.

Is this plugin SEO friendly?

Yes. Using page category and page tag improves content organization and internal linking, which supports better SEO structure.

Does it work with Gutenberg?

Yes. It works perfectly with the Block Editor and Classic Editor.

Does it slow down my website?

No. The plugin is lightweight and only enables taxonomy support for pages.

Do I need coding knowledge?

No. Just install and activate. Everything works automatically.
